source_identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw SHA-256(file bytes), over tracked and non-ignored untracked source, excluding docs/evidence/, plans/progress.json, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json and SHA256SUMS.txt; every recorded command is bound to this identity.
scope: C19 explainable interaction and configurable per-sensor HTTP request rate signals in the existing local --project-segments workflow. Alerts reference exact C18 indexed source records; durable C15 gaps appear as separate sensor_health findings; incomplete C18 coverage remains explicit. No schema, migration, API, UI or dependency added.

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic events, expected alert references and negative input cases; no customer or sensor data.

results.positive: Four synthetic valid HTTP request events yield four interaction findings. Three sensor-01 events over the explicit 5-second window meet the fixture-supplied count limit 3 and reference their C18 segment, record, sequence and digest. The separate sensor-02 health finding comes from durable gap records only.
results.negative: Zero/missing rate policy is rejected; malformed event source and digest-tampered source reference return typed errors. The versioned negative fixture is consumed by tests.
results.durability: The real child-process --project-segments workflow produced alerts, exited, reopened persistent segments and reproduced identical alert JSON/references; C05 inputs and receipts were byte-for-byte unchanged.
results.coverage: C18 index completeness is carried as coverage_complete. Missing event identities lower coverage and are never converted into a clean/no-alert assertion. No sensor-offline inference is made.
results.discovery: Six Go suites and 129 required engine test anchors accepted by the workflow discovery guard; Go race suite passed.
results.security: Alert derivation is local/read-only, validates source event identity and SHA-256 digest against C18 references, validates durable gap records and their operation IDs, copies no raw request path/content into alerts, and introduces no network/process execution API.

security_review: Caller-provided positive rate limit and whole-second window are mandatory when alert derivation is requested; no hidden product default is selected.
Source bytes are decoded and checked against indexed sensor/event/sequence, digest, payload length, segment and record references before findings are returned.
Durable spool gaps are decoded and operation-ID checked. Missing index records and incomplete coverage do not become sensor-health or attack claims.
No database, HTTP, UI, environment, Dockerfile, dependency or sibling-repository changes were made; no raw path is emitted in alert output.
limits: GitHub-hosted Actions were not triggered; local workflow-equivalent commands passed.
Local source-integrity validation proves the committed tree identity, not runtime behavior.
No deployment, publication or product-readiness claim is made.
